newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NKF shares dive on profits warning.
newsitem.headline: NKF shares dive on profits warning.

text.p: Shares in Dutch cable maker NKF Holding fell 21 percent on Monday after it said it expected 1997 profits to be significantly below those of 1996.
The shares stood at 58.00 guilders at 1230 GMT, 15.50 below the previous close, after earlier hitting a low of 57.70.
Dealers attributed the price slump to the profits warning and problems for its power cable business, particularly in Germany.
"Obviously everybody was focusing too much on the telecoms cable business, which has been experiencing nice demand. The problem was in the other corner," said one dealer.
